hunks.baseline: In the slowed world, the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord knew instinctively as the old man plunged down like a flash of light, dagger in hand.
hunks.sol: In the slowed world, the old man plunged down like a flash of light, dagger in hand. The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord knew instinctively.

hunks.baseline: It was an utterly perfect ambush.
hunks.sol: The ambush was that perfect.

hunks.baseline: An unavoidable strike for even the Fire King Jeok Cheongang as he was now—no, all the more unavoidable because he had lost his composure and was angrier than ever.
hunks.sol: Even the Fire King Jeok Cheongang as he was now could not evade it. No—he was angrier than ever, his composure gone, which made evasion even less likely.

hunks.baseline: Even if he somehow managed to block or dodge it and escape death, the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord judged that severe injuries were inevitable.
hunks.sol: Even if he somehow blocked or dodged the strike and escaped death, the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord judged that he could not escape severe injury.

hunks.baseline: The grand plan was already on the verge of falling apart.
hunks.sol: The grand plan was already on the verge of falling apart. Survival came first now.

hunks.baseline: Survival came first now.
No matter how long it took or what means he had to use, he had to finish his revenge with his own hands.

He could not die until he had watched with his own two eyes as the imperial family, heirs to that cursed bloodline, was wiped out—and offered a memorial rite for his Master and fellow disciples, who had met untimely deaths.
hunks.sol: No matter how long it took or what means he had to use, he had to finish his revenge with his own hands. He could not die until he had watched with his own two eyes as the imperial family, heirs to that cursed bloodline, was wiped out—and offered a memorial rite for his Master and fellow disciples, who had met untimely deaths.

hunks.baseline: But to begin a revenge that might never come again, he first had to bring down the monster bearing down on him.
hunks.sol: But if he was ever to resume that revenge, he first had to bring down the monster before him.

hunks.baseline: The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord was certain of it. At the same time, he prayed fervently for it.
hunks.sol: The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord was certain Jeok Cheongang would die. At the same time, he desperately hoped he was right.

hunks.baseline: And then, just as the dagger in the old man’s hand—its blade dulled by a coating of ash—brought Force to bear, about to cut Jeok Cheongang in two—
hunks.sol: Just as the old man’s dagger—its blade dulled by a coating of ash and charged with Force—was about to cut Jeok Cheongang in two—

hunks.baseline: A sound of something piercing the air rang out from somewhere, reaching the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s ears.
hunks.sol: A sound of something piercing the air rang out from somewhere and reached the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s ears. It drowned out every other sound as it tore furiously through the air.

hunks.baseline: It drowned out every other sound as it tore through the air in a furious rush.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes flew wide. A blue-white flash had reached its destination before its sound did, filling his vision.
hunks.sol: His eyes flew wide. A blue-white flash had reached its destination before its sound did, filling his vision.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, who had belatedly realized the assassin had appeared out of nowhere. The old man plunging down at him like a bolt of lightning. And the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, watching it all unfold.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, who had only just noticed the assassin. The old man plunging down at him like a bolt of lightning. And the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, watching it all unfold.

hunks.baseline: They all watched the spearhead cut through the air toward them, moving as if in slow motion. They felt the power within the blue-white flames coiling around its point.
hunks.sol: They all watched the spearhead cut slowly through the air toward them. They felt the power within the blue-white flames coiling around it.

hunks.baseline: What root that horrifyingly intense Scorching Yang Qi came from.
hunks.sol: Where that horrifyingly intense Scorching Yang Qi came from.

hunks.baseline: Before the three-syllable name that had suddenly surfaced could even take shape in their minds, the spearhead had raced forward, erasing the space between them, and reached its destination in an instant.
hunks.sol: Before the three-syllable name that had sprung to mind could even take shape, the spearhead had erased the space between them and reached its target.

hunks.baseline: At the life-or-death moment, the old man frantically changed the direction of his dagger and brought it up to block the spearhead that had come within inches of him.
hunks.sol: At the last possible moment, the old man frantically turned his dagger to block the spearhead bearing down on him.

hunks.baseline: A blood-soaked man, from head to toe, approached with movements lighter and quicker than ever. He showed his white teeth and grinned.
hunks.sol: A man drenched in blood from head to toe approached, moving more lightly and swiftly than ever. He bared his white teeth in a grin.

hunks.baseline: Then he shrugged toward one man standing dazed and motionless at the feet of the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, who was sprawled there, stiff as a statue.
hunks.sol: Then he shrugged at the man standing dazed beside the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, who lay sprawled on the ground, stiff as a statue.

hunks.baseline: No—he couldn’t answer.
hunks.sol: No—he couldn’t.

hunks.baseline: He silently gazed at his Disciple, who had come back as he always did. Then he burst out laughing.
hunks.sol: He gazed in silence at his Disciple, who had come back as he always did. Then he burst out laughing.

hunks.baseline: He was so delighted that tears came to his eyes.
At the same time, he felt all the anger and sorrow that had held his whole body in its grip come crashing down, and he grasped his Disciple’s arm tightly.
hunks.sol: He laughed so hard that tears came to his eyes. As he did, all the anger and sorrow that had held his body in their grip came crashing down. He seized his Disciple’s arm.

hunks.baseline: “For coming back. For coming back to me like this.”
hunks.sol: “For coming back. For coming back like this.”

hunks.baseline: The blood-dried corner of the blood-soaked man’s eye—no, Jin Taekyung’s eye—trembled.
hunks.sol: The corner of Jin Taekyung’s eye, caked with dried blood, trembled.

hunks.baseline: It was a brief sentence, but it was enough.
hunks.sol: A few words, but they were enough.

hunks.baseline: He could feel the warmth conveyed through that arm, and the sincerity that seeped into every syllable of his Master’s words.
hunks.sol: He felt the warmth of his Master’s hand on his arm and the sincerity in every syllable.

hunks.baseline: That feeling meant everything.
hunks.sol: That feeling was more than enough.

hunks.baseline: And so, there was no need for them to say anything more.
hunks.sol: There was no need for them to say anything more.

hunks.baseline: This brief reunion between the two men who had carried on the Fire Gate Clan’s lineage would soon become the deaths of their enemies.
hunks.sol: This brief reunion between the two men who carried on the Fire Gate Clan’s lineage would soon mean death for their enemies.

hunks.baseline: That was how the Fire Gate Clan had survived for the past three hundred years. It was the way of these two, bound together as Master and Disciple by a connection no one could explain.
hunks.sol: That was how the Fire Gate Clan had survived for three hundred years. It was also the way of these two, bound as Master and Disciple by an inexplicable connection.

hunks.baseline: *We’ll smash and burn everything in our way.*
hunks.sol: *Smash and burn everything in our way.*

hunks.baseline: We will. Without fail.
hunks.sol: Without fail.

hunks.baseline: Master and Disciple moved forward at the same time. Beyond the dust cloud and ash that had yet to settle, a sticky killing intent crept toward them in secret, wrapping around them.
hunks.sol: Master and Disciple moved forward together. Beyond the unsettled dust and ash, sticky killing intent crept toward them and wrapped around them.

hunks.baseline: Even as he watched his subordinates die less than a dozen *jang* away, there wasn’t a trace of agitation in his cool, sunken eyes.
hunks.sol: Even as he watched his subordinates die less than a dozen *jang* away, there wasn’t a trace of agitation in his cold, sunken eyes.

hunks.baseline: Anyone who saw this would find it hard to believe.
Each of those men crumpling like straw dummies was an elite assassin he had spent at least thirty years cultivating.
hunks.sol: Anyone who saw those men crumpling like straw dummies would find it hard to believe that each was an elite assassin he had spent at least thirty years training.

hunks.baseline: His ambush just moments earlier had been that perfect. He could have erased the giant known as the Fire King Jeok Cheongang from this world with his own hands.
hunks.sol: His ambush moments earlier had been that perfect. He could have erased the giant known as the Fire King Jeok Cheongang from this world himself.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t just the pain in his broken wrist, which had snapped as he deflected the spear filled with immense energy at the last moment before success.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t only because his broken wrist throbbed. It had snapped when he deflected that spear, so full of power, at the last moment before his ambush succeeded.

hunks.baseline: He had seen it with his own eyes in the darkness.
hunks.sol: He had seen it clearly from the darkness.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung, falling with an injury beyond recovery. The shadow of death stirring at the edge of his life as he coughed up blood mixed with pieces of his organs.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung falling with an injury beyond recovery. Coughing up blood mixed with pieces of his organs, with the shadow of death stirring at the edge of his life.

hunks.baseline: Those who roam the martial world with death for a companion are martial artists. And among them, assassins stand closest to death.
hunks.sol: Martial artists roamed the martial world with death for a companion. Of all of them, assassins stood closest to it.

hunks.baseline: That was why Heaven’s Slaughter knew better than anyone.
hunks.sol: Heaven’s Slaughter knew that better than anyone.

hunks.baseline: Since the time he had been trained as an assassin, he had killed people with his own hands using every means at his disposal. For the weight of those deeds, he had even reached death’s threshold himself.
hunks.sol: Since early childhood, when he had been trained as an assassin, he had killed people with his own hands in every way he could. The weight of those deeds had brought him to death’s threshold, too.

hunks.baseline: Heaven’s Slaughter’s survival was a miracle. But even that seemed insignificant beside what Jin Taekyung had shown just now.
hunks.sol: Heaven’s Slaughter’s survival had been a miracle. But even that seemed insignificant beside what Jin Taekyung had just done.

hunks.baseline: There was no doubt. Force had pierced straight through his chest.
hunks.sol: There was no doubt. Force had pierced straight through Jin Taekyung’s chest.

hunks.baseline: It had split flesh and bone, destroyed his acupoints, and seeped into his organs, tearing them to shreds from within.
hunks.sol: It had split flesh and bone, destroyed his acupoints, and penetrated his organs, tearing them to shreds from within.

hunks.baseline: This was an injury no one could recover from—not even with the Great Firmament Immortal’s care, or if Yama himself erased their name from the book of the dead.
hunks.sol: No one could recover from such an injury—not even under the care of a Great Firmament Immortal, or if Yama himself erased their name from the book of the dead.

hunks.baseline: Though he looked like a man drenched in blood, his exposed skin was smooth, and his perfectly formed Muscles and Bones—the reason he was known as having a Heavenly Martial Physique—were plain to see.
hunks.sol: He was drenched in blood, but the skin beneath it was smooth. His Muscles and Bones, so perfect that he was said to possess a Heavenly Martial Physique, were intact.

hunks.baseline: His formidable internal energy, amounting to several *jiazi*’s worth—impossible to believe in someone who had only just passed the age of twenty—had also filled back up as if nothing had happened.
hunks.sol: His formidable internal energy—several *jiazi*’s worth, an impossible amount for someone barely past twenty—had filled back up as if nothing had happened.

hunks.baseline: As if someone had filled an empty teacup with water.
hunks.sol: As easily as pouring water into an empty teacup.

hunks.baseline: An ability that transcended all reason.
hunks.sol: An ability beyond reason.

hunks.baseline: Heaven’s Slaughter’s deeply sunken eyes trembled.
hunks.sol: Heaven’s Slaughter’s sunken eyes trembled faintly.

hunks.baseline: Now, his composure—barely held together until this moment—had finally crumbled. He was truly torn between two choices.
hunks.sol: His composure, barely maintained until now, had begun to crumble. For the first time, he was truly torn between two choices.

hunks.baseline: Flight and duty.
hunks.sol: Flight or duty.

hunks.baseline: And he wondered who would kill him: Dark Heaven or Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: And between whose hands he would die by: Dark Heaven’s or Jin Taekyung’s.

hunks.baseline: Several decades ago, when Heaven’s Slaughter had been gasping at death’s door, Dark Heaven had made him an offer he could not refuse. It had never been out of pure kindness.
hunks.sol: Several decades ago, when he had been gasping at death’s door, Dark Heaven had made him an offer he could not refuse. It had never been out of kindness.

hunks.baseline: That was the new identity Heaven’s Slaughter had exchanged his life for. A shackle he could never break, no matter how far he ran.
hunks.sol: That was the new identity Heaven’s Slaughter had accepted in exchange for his life. A shackle he could never break, no matter how far he ran.

hunks.baseline: A horrible death in unbearable pain, beyond even what a man who had spent his life committing countless murders could imagine.
hunks.sol: Pain and death so terrible that even he, after a lifetime of killing, could not imagine them.

hunks.baseline: There was nowhere to hide. Nowhere to run.
hunks.sol: He could not hide. He could not escape.

hunks.baseline: He thought himself a fool for agonizing over a problem whose answer had already been decided.
hunks.sol: What a fool he was, agonizing over a question whose answer had been decided from the start.

hunks.baseline: There had never been a choice to make.
hunks.sol: There had never been a choice to make. Only one path lay before him.

hunks.baseline: There had only ever been one path in front of him. One option.
He silenced his breathing and erased his presence. Watching the elite assassins he had carefully raised with Dark Heaven’s help get slaughtered, he slowly approached Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: He silenced his breathing and erased his presence. Watching the elite assassins he had painstakingly raised with Dark Heaven’s help get slaughtered, he slowly approached Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: *If I can take down even one of them, I can survive—even if I fail the mission and flee.*
hunks.sol: *Just one. If I can take down either of them, I can survive—even if I fail the mission and flee.*

hunks.baseline: A chance to carry on his unfulfilled revenge, to keep this stubborn life going.
hunks.sol: A chance to pursue his own unfulfilled revenge. A chance to keep this stubborn life going.

hunks.baseline: Another life vanished with a piercing sound. But unlike Jin Taekyung, who was rampaging as if possessed, Jeok Cheongang looked utterly exhausted to Heaven’s Slaughter.
hunks.sol: Another life vanished with a sound of rushing air. But unlike Jin Taekyung, who was rampaging as if possessed, Jeok Cheongang looked utterly exhausted to Heaven’s Slaughter.

hunks.baseline: Hidden weapons came flying from every direction, grazing Jeok Cheongang’s body. Then, after killing with a single palm strike the assassin who had dropped down from above, the old dragon exhaled raggedly through his lips.
hunks.sol: Hidden weapons flew at Jeok Cheongang from every direction, grazing his body. He killed an assassin dropping from above with a single palm strike, then let out a ragged breath.

hunks.baseline: At the sight of Jeok Cheongang, who seemed to have forgotten the fearsome martial prowess he had displayed only moments ago, Heaven’s Slaughter muttered to himself.
hunks.sol: He seemed a far cry from the Jeok Cheongang who had displayed such fearsome martial prowess only moments ago. Heaven’s Slaughter thought to himself:

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang had already drawn out martial prowess beyond his limits against the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, and his body had been covered in large and small wounds even before that.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang had already surpassed his limits against the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, and even before that, his body had been covered in wounds large and small.

hunks.baseline: And that opening was Heaven’s Slaughter’s only chance.
hunks.sol: That opening was Heaven’s Slaughter’s only chance.

hunks.baseline: Heaven’s Slaughter calmed his mind. He erased even his killing intent—the very energy anyone about to kill someone would carry.
hunks.sol: Heaven’s Slaughter calmed his mind. He erased even his killing intent—the energy anyone about to kill would carry.

hunks.baseline: No one feels murderous intent when killing livestock instead of a human.
hunks.sol: No one harbors killing intent when slaughtering livestock instead of a human being.

hunks.baseline: After living his whole life as a butcher under the name of assassin, he finally shot straight forward with all his might.
hunks.sol: He had spent his life as a butcher called an assassin. Now he shot straight forward with all his might.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, he realized.
hunks.sol: And at that same moment, he understood.

hunks.baseline: Though he himself was still cloaked by his concealment technique, he saw Jin Taekyung staring straight at him. He felt that gaze pierce his entire body.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung was staring straight at him, though he was still cloaked by his concealment technique. Heaven’s Slaughter felt that gaze pierce through his entire body.
